column3: MT 21:2. “Trembled to meet David” is rendered “came trembling.”
MT 21:3. “A place of a certain one, a certain one” is rendered “a certain place.”
MT 21:4. “Under your hand” is rendered “on hand.”
MT 21:5. “Bread of profaneness” is rendered “ordinary bread,” and “bread of holiness” as “consecrated bread.”
MT 21:6. “As yesterday three days ago” is rendered “as previously”; the Hebrew is difficult and the meaning is uncertain.
MT 21:8. “The mighty one of the shepherds” is rendered “the chief of Saul’s shepherds.”
MT 21:9. “And where is there here” is rendered “Now is there not.”
MT 21:12. “With the dances” is rendered “as they danced.”
MT 21:14. “He changed his sense” is rendered “he disguised his sanity,” and “made marks” as “scribbled.”
MT 21:16. “On me” is rendered “in my presence.”
